## History

Harmon Andrews is a resident of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) whose wife, Mrs. Harmon Andrews, later brags to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about their daughter Jane's lavish engagement.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Weddings P0](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0000), [v3 ch.Weddings P7](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0007), [v3 ch.Weddings P28](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0028), [v3 ch.Weddings P41](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0041)_

## Quotes

> "Well, the over-particular girls generally get left, I notice. And what’s this I hear about Gilbert Blythe being engaged to a Miss Stuart? Charlie Sloane tells me she is perfectly beautiful. Is it true?"
>
> — Harmon Andrews — [v3 ch.Weddings P29](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0029)

> “I once thought you and Gilbert would have made a match of it,” said Mrs. Harmon. “If you don’t take care, Anne, all of your beaux will slip through your fingers.”
>
> — Harmon Andrews — [v3 ch.Weddings P31](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0031)

> “Do,” said Mrs. Harmon effusively. “Jane isn’t a bit proud. She just means to associate with her old friends the same as ever. She’ll be real glad to see you.”
>
> — Harmon Andrews — [v3 ch.Weddings P34](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0034)

## Relationships

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/harmon-andrews--jane-andrews.md)

Harmon Andrews once saved [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) by catching her by her sash when she nearly fell overboard into the [Lake of Shining Waters](../codex/places.md#lake-of-shining-waters).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068)_
